0.7.4 is a drop-in patch for 0.7.0, 0.7.1, 0.7.2 and 0.7.3: format epoch 3 is unchanged, with no storage, snapshot, WAL or Raft protocol change. Upgrade in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`). No fresh install or data move is needed.

- **Gateway metrics and the upgrade.** A gateway with access control (`--auth-issuer`) now answers `404` on `/__ursula/gateway/metrics` ([#548](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/548)). If something scrapes that path, add `--auth-public-metrics` to `gateway.extraArgs` in the same `helm upgrade` that moves the gateways to 0.7.4, because a 0.7.3 gateway exits at startup on the unknown flag. The flag makes the counters public. From 0.7.0, a values file that pins `global.image.tag` or `gateway.image.tag` must move it together with the chart, as for 0.7.1, and from 0.7.2 or earlier the 0.7.3 upgrade notes apply too.
- **Snapshot builds escalate before the Raft log hard limit** ([#519](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/519)). Past `raft.snapshot_log_budget` a node runs more snapshot builds at once, up to `raft.snapshot_build_max_concurrency`, whose default rises from 1 to 2. With the snapshot sizes of #519, two builds hold about 11 MB in the common case, about 270 MB for two of the largest groups and about 400 MB if both fall back to inline snapshots. Set it to 1 to keep one build at a time. The chart renders it only when `raft.snapshotBuildMaxConcurrency` is set, so a 0.7.3 server started under the 0.7.4 chart keeps its own default of 1. On a 3-voter test cluster with real S3 and 128 SQLite VFS owners writing flat out, 0.7.3, and 0.7.4 set to one build, crossed the hard limit on every node, while the default of 2 stayed well below it. Of the existing metrics, only `raft_snapshot_pressure_passes` changed meaning.
- **Placeholder until [#558](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/pull/558) merges: an operator's snapshot waits for a build permit** ([#529](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/529)). `POST /__ursula/raft/{group}/snapshot` waits for a build permit and answers `503` with `Retry-After: 1` when no build of the group can start within 10 s.
- **Refusals the gateway decides from the request head reach clients that send the body first** ([#540](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/540)). Before a `401`, `403`, `404`, `429` or one of its `503`s for an unavailable token issuer or authorizer, the gateway reads and discards the body, stopping after 5 s without new data or 30 s in all. A large SQLite VFS commit refused this way now fails alone instead of poisoning the database. A refused upload costs the gateway its ingress.
- **The SQLite VFS is no longer experimental.** Within a minor release the formats stay compatible, but a patch release can still change the API, as 0.7.3 did, and the release notes say how to upgrade.
- **SQLite VFS: a commit whose attempts never went out fails alone**, with `refused_kind` `unreachable` and its producer sequence free, instead of poisoning the database. The extension caches host addresses for 30 s, keeps the last ones for up to 10 minutes while lookups fail, and on macOS retries a reset reported as `Invalid argument (os error 22)` ([#542](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/542)). TypeScript's `WriteRefusedKind` gains `unreachable`.
- **Rust library APIs changed** in `ursula-raft` (`SnapshotBuildCoordinator` and `snapshot_cadence`), `ursula-runtime` (`RuntimeMetrics` and `RuntimeMetricsSnapshot`), `ursula-gateway` (`AccessControl::with_public_metrics`) and `ursula-config` (the default of `snapshot_build_max_concurrency`), with no wire or on-disk change.

Known issues: [#411](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/411), [#461](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/461), [#465](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/465), [#484](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/484), [#490](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/490), [#494](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/494), [#496](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/496), [#497](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/497), [#517](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/517), [#518](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/518), [#539](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/539), [#550](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/550) and [#561](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/561). Every change is listed in the [0.7.4 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#074).
